data.promptProse: At a formal tea gathering, Yuki holds her cup with impeccable posture in a modest pale-violet kimono-style dress and cream sash. She briefly turns to breathe in relief before restoring her composed expression. The medium view includes the tea service below and seated elders farther back. Window light softens her face and opaque dress layers, catching the cup rim above her shaded fingers.
